sections.domain: Withdrawal of driving privileges and points
sections.heading: Withdrawal of driving privileges and points
sections.markdown:
## Withdrawal of driving privileges and points

FACT_ID: sec13-R01 | anchor: A01
Points arise from designated convictions, including out-of-state violations that would carry points if committed in Georgia. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=49]

FACT_ID: sec13-R02 | anchor: A01
The handbook's general points threshold is at least 15 points accumulated within 24 months. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=49]

FACT_ID: sec13-R03 | anchor: A01
Georgia suspends the license of any driver younger than twenty-one convicted of a four-point violation, and of any driver younger than eighteen who accumulates four points within twelve months [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=49]

FACT_ID: sec13-R04 | anchor: A01
The violation date determines the handbook's points-accumulation window. For a single high-point offense at ages 18 through 20, the conviction date determines the age-based suspension. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=49]

FACT_ID: sec13-R05 | anchor: A01
After suspension for accumulated points, the handbook says the points total returns to zero. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=49]

FACT_ID: sec13-R06 | anchor: A01
For the handbook's suspensions applying below age 21, a no-contest plea is treated as a conviction. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=49]

FACT_ID: sec13-R07 | anchor: A01
A licensed Georgia resident may request removal of up to 7 points once every 5 years under the handbook's points-reduction program. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=49]

FACT_ID: sec13-R08 | anchor: A01
The points-reduction request requires successful completion of a certified 6-hour driver-improvement course and the original completion certificate submitted to DDS in person or by mail. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=49]

FACT_ID: sec13-R09 | anchor: A01
The separate points-avoidance process uses a certified 6-hour improvement course completed after the citation and before the court appearance, or as the court orders. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=49]

FACT_ID: sec13-R10 | anchor: A01
For the described points-avoidance plea, the original certificate goes to the court; the handbook describes a 20-percent fine reduction and no assessed points, with acceptance available once every 5 years. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=49]

FACT_ID: sec13-R11 | anchor: A01
An unsatisfied crash-damage claim under the safety-responsibility law can lead to an order suspending the license. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=49]

FACT_ID: sec13-R12 | anchor: A01
For a safety-responsibility claim, one listed way to avoid suspension is having the insurer file SR-21 showing liability coverage at the time of the crash. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=49]

FACT_ID: sec13-R13 | anchor: A01
Another listed safety-responsibility response is a general or conditional release signed by the claimant and filed with DDS. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=49]

FACT_ID: sec13-R14 | anchor: A01
The handbook also permits qualifying security for the claimed damages together with the required financial-responsibility filing; DDS holds security for a year and then until the required proof concerning a lawsuit is provided. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=49]

FACT_ID: sec13-R15 | anchor: A01
A person receiving the safety-responsibility suspension order may request a hearing within 10 days of receiving it. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=49]

FACT_ID: sec13-R16 | anchor: A01
An eligible limited permit restricts driving to approved purposes such as work, scheduled medical care or prescriptions, education, treatment meetings, court or probation duties, community service and specified trips for unlicensed immediate family. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=49]

FACT_ID: sec13-R17 | anchor: A01
DDS may further limit a permit by destinations, routes, times or vehicle. A limited permit does not authorize commercial-vehicle operation. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=49]

FACT_ID: sec13-R18 | anchor: A01
A conviction for a moving violation or violation of the permit's own restrictions results in revocation of the limited permit; the handbook also describes extending the underlying suspension. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=49]

FACT_ID: sec13-R19 | anchor: A02
Eligibility for a limited driving permit depends on the applicable offense, age and conviction record. DDS makes the final eligibility decision; the handbook's examples do not guarantee a permit. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=50]

Misconceptions: A withdrawal period ending does not itself establish that every reinstatement requirement has been met; a limited permit does not restore unrestricted driving.
Mnemonic: Reason, action, conditions, application, reinstatement.
Glossary: Cancellation addresses eligibility or application defects; suspension is temporary withdrawal; revocation terminates the privilege for the imposed period.
Dynamic-fact isolation: Testing rights, penalties, points programs, deadlines and permit eligibility retain current legal review and are not individualized legal advice.

verification_debt.claim_text: The dated handbook facts retain source freshness, rights and independent factual-review debt; no current-law equivalence or live service/fee policy is certified.
The extracted offense-to-points table loses row alignment; exact per-offense values are withheld rather than reconstructed from the separated text.
Implied-consent refusal duration, legal-limit duration, trial-evidence admissibility and full current testing rights require legal verification; the older summary is not treated as current counsel.

The complete limited-permit eligible/ineligible offense matrix, its exceptions, drug-violation branches, suspension extensions, probationary-license waiting period and fee require current legal confirmation and are withheld; DDS's final decision remains explicit.
Detailed security instruments, mailing addresses, course-provider links and contact numbers require current administrative confirmation.

Commercial-license disqualification, hazardous-materials, out-of-service and commercial railroad-violation rules are outside the declared regular passenger-car path, including the commercial-refusal-to-weigh grounds.
